_about: GuardTorsoTurn.cs (laneGUARD2 v82): how far the torso turns toward the guarded side while a side guard is held (DuelFighter.guardSide 1 left, 2 right; top = no turn). turnDeg = the TOTAL turn: 26 = Frankendom V3 GUARD_TILT 0.45 rad (characters.ts line 495). bakedDeg = the turn the guard_left / guard_right clips already carry in Spine2 (about 10 deg, measured by the A2 audit), so the code adds turnDeg - bakedDeg = 16 deg on top of the clip. Set bakedDeg to 0 if the sheet shows the clip has no turn. blendInSeconds / blendOutSeconds = ease of the extra turn when the guard goes up / drops. spine = bones that share the extra yaw (shares add up to 1; a name not found in the rig is skipped). sides[].dir: -1 turns to the fighter's left, +1 to the right, 0 none; flip a sign here if the MoveSheet shows a side leaning the wrong way. characters = roster ids that get the turn (turnDeg / bakedDeg -1 = the values above, any other value overrides for that character). enabled false or no file = the old look (the clips only).
